Cha-ching! 💸 Looking for a job that makes your bank account and your schedule happy? As a Warehouse Employee at DPD in Veenendaal, you start with a solid salary of € 14.99. But wait, it gets even better! With good evening, night and weekend allowances, you can earn up to € 22.49 per hour! Whether you want to work full-time or part-time, the choice is yours! Curious what else we offer? Read on!🚀

What we offer
- Top-tier salary of € 14.99 per hour💰
- Allowances up to 50%📈
- Travel allowance🚗
- Get paid every week🗓️
- 50% discount on sending your own parcels📦
- Chance at a fixed contract after just 12 weeks📝

Who you are
We are looking for a powerhouse! You want to be where the action is. As our new Warehouse Employee, you bring the energy, and we bring the work. Furthermore, you check these boxes:

- You are 18+ (safety first!🛡️)
- You are available for at least 2 days a week📅
- You’re ready to rock the afternoon, intermediate, or night shifts🌙

Get ready for a workout! As a Warehouse Employee at DPD, you’ll be unloading trucks filled with packages. Easy-peasy money, right? 😉

- Working days: Monday to Saturday.

- Afternoon: 14:00 - 22:30
- Intermediate: 20:00 - 06:30 (Inbetween those hours)

Where will you work
You’ll find us at Kazemat 32 in Veenendaal, the beating heart of DPD. Forget boring offices; here, you work in a high-energy environment where your colleagues become your friends. ?
